picks.title: Backed by $60M in funding, Oak steps out of stealth to fix the identity mess that AI agents are making worse
picks.why_it_matters: A $60M seed for identity management signals that AI agent infrastructure is becoming a major investable category, with authentication/authorization emerging as a critical bottleneck as autonomous agents proliferate.

picks.title: Indian AI coding startup Emergent becomes a unicorn with $130M Series C
picks.why_it_matters: Reaching $120M ARR and unicorn status in just over a year demonstrates the velocity possible in AI developer tools, while validating India as a source of globally competitive AI startups.

picks.title: Anthropic, Blackstone bet the next trillion-dollar AI business is implementation, not just models
picks.why_it_matters: Major AI labs moving into services signals that enterprise AI deployment—not model development—is the emerging value layer, creating opportunities for startups building implementation tooling and vertical-specific solutions.
